title: How Greenlight Financial built an autonomous SOC solution on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
summary: Greenlight Financial resolves more than 90% of up to 4,000 monthly security and risk cases without human intervention using Luna, a tiered multi-agent system on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. This post covers the architecture, episodic memory for continuous learning, and the expansion
reason: Customer case study on AWS blog describing Greenlight's multi-agent SOC system 'Luna' built on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. No named model release (AgentCore is a platform, Luna is the customer's system), no research artifact, no policy action, no business event, and no open-source tool release.
